semantics.evidence: Original problem explicitly requires positive-edge sequential logic and lists all six states, their outputs, and both outgoing transitions.
semantics.clock: State changes at posedge clk; z is the combinational Moore output of the current state.
semantics.reset: Assume active-high synchronous reset to A, with priority over w. Synchronous timing follows the positive-edge-only requirement; polarity and destination are not explicitly stated.
semantics.initialization: No initial state specified; do not initialize state before reset.

verification.cases: All 256 eight-bit input sequences from reset, all twelve state/input transitions, reset priority from every state with each w, synchronous reset between edges
verification.completion: Fatal mismatches, bounded timeout, PASS only after coverage checks
